title: Writing / Glossary / Words to use
slide_intent: Choose one form for recurring words so readers are not distracted by inconsistent spelling and grammatical use.
strategic_value: A practical lookup of common terms can help Duolingo align many writers without requiring case-by-case debate.
demonstration: Six groups compare preferred forms with alternatives for okay, website, internet, login-related wording and anytime.
practical_value: Check the word’s grammatical role before choosing log in or login, and follow the listed spellings for other recurring terms.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place Words to Use and the explanation of spelling choices at left.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Stack six comparison groups at right with checked preferred wording, sample sentences and rejected forms underneath.

reference_purposes.Application: Examples show preferred forms in complete lines of copy.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The guide prefers okay, website, lowercase internet and anytime; it separates log in/log out/sign up as verbs from login as a noun or adjective.

ingredient.name: Preferred word forms
ingredient.application: Use the displayed spellings; distinguish verb phrases log in, log out and sign up from the noun or adjective login.
ingredient.scope: Historical official guidelines from the 2024–2025 archived snapshot; this records the displayed guidance, not current Duolingo product behavior.
